name: Gumbo-limbo
desc: West Indian Birch (Bursera simaruba): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 232 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Bursera simaruba, the gumbo-limbo, copperwood, tourist tree, turpentine tree, almácigo, or West Indian birch, is a tree species in the family Burseraceae.
